name: Mobile-Bench
description: With the remarkable advancements of large language models (LLMs), LLM-based agents have become a research hotspot in human-computer interaction. However, there is a scarcity of benchmarks available for LLM-based mobile agents. Benchmarking these agents generally faces three main challenges: (1) The inefficiency of UI-only operations imposes limitations to task evaluation.
reputation: A recent benchmark for evaluating LLM-based mobile agents, but it is not yet as widely established as older agent benchmarks.
notes: Mobile-agent benchmark with UI interaction and multi-step task execution; results can be sensitive to environment setup and simulator fidelity.
